text:
Asking rents in Bochum stand at a median of 9.58 €/m² (2026-06), up 4.5% on the year and +24.9% over five years. That ranks Bochum #31 of 37 cities; new lets are priced 53% above the 2022 average contract rent of 6.25 €/m².

A 60 m² flat costs about 575 € a month in cold rent, 13.9% of the disposable income of two residents. Listings stay online for about 31 days and 20% are gone within a week; with 2.2% market-active vacancy and +0.3% population growth over five years, the market looks broadly balanced.

The model estimate for twelve months ahead is 10.09 €/m² (+5.3%), with an 80% range of 9.80 to 10.30 €/m²; housing-loan rates are at 4.01%.
